chunks: Say: 'Believe in it or do not believe. Those who were given knowledge before it, when it is recited to them, fall down on their faces in prostration.'

key_terms.الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْعِلْمَ: Those who were given knowledge / People of Knowledge

ai.seo_question: Who are the 'People of Knowledge' mentioned in Surah Al-Isra who fall in prostration when the Quran is recited?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the spiritual integrity of the 'People of Knowledge' (Ahl al-Ilm), who, unlike those who merely recite, are compelled by divine truth to prostrate, illustrating that true knowledge culminates in humble submission. This reaction is often linked to the Imams and the Ahl al-Bayt, who embody the perfect union of deep understanding and devotional worship. It serves as a model for believers, emphasizing that intellectual grasp of the Quran must inevitably lead to physical and spiritual prostration before God.
